title: Briefing
description: A staff briefing with exactly three policy-scenario branches (raise/hold/lower), each carrying a macro forecast payload. All player-facing text is localization keys. Shape is stable for SPEC-BRIEF-2 quality scoring.

name.description: Localization key for the briefing title, e.g. brief.1979_q3_stagflation.name.

desc.description: Localization key for the briefing summary, e.g. brief.1979_q3_stagflation.desc.

scenarios.description: Exactly three policy-scenario branches in order: raise, hold, lower.

Forecast.description: Macro forecast payload for a policy scenario; stable extension point for SPEC-BRIEF-2 quality scoring.

inflation_outlook.description: Projected annualized inflation rate over the forecast horizon (e.g. 0.12 = 12%).

unemployment_outlook.description: Projected unemployment rate over the forecast horizon.

growth_outlook.description: Optional projected real GDP growth rate over the forecast horizon.

scenario_type.description: The policy direction this branch describes.

name.description: Localization key for this scenario branch, e.g. brief.1979_q3_stagflation.raise.name.
